description: The roots of Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a research field are usually traced back to a workshop held in 1956 on the campus of Dartmouth College.

instances.assertion: The roots of Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a research field are usually traced back to a workshop held in 1956 on the campus of Dartmouth College.
The Dartmouth workshop in 1956 is widely considered the founding event of AI as a research field.
